entries.title: Finished tasks' leftover files are removed after a week
entries.body: A week after a task closes, the app removes the pictures, logs and other files its crewmate saved while working, so they no longer fill your Mac. A task's record, its cards and their pictures stay, and files stay while other open work still builds on that task.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the app frees disk space in the background.
